summary: Sheet #54 (Smart Training, Quiz & DIY Skill Builder Engine) — full backend + frontend verification. All 13 pytest cases pass (100%). Mobile /skills screen renders hero, badges, quiz cards, quiz modal with grading UI (correct/wrong highlighting, explanations, retake, done), mentor opt-in card, and leaderboard. SkillCheckBanner appears on project workspace whose title matches a quiz topic (Plumbing/Electrical) and 'Take it' navigates to /skills?quizId= and auto-opens the quiz. Admin /admin → Skill Quizzes shows totals, per-topic pass rate, quiz list with active toggle/delete, and a working New quiz builder (creates then delete verified). Regression: project workspace continues to generate & render guides normally with the new banner rendered above the guide body. No React Native red-screen errors detected; no deprecated packages introduced by this sheet.

minor.issue: Returns 405 Method Not Allowed. Not part of #54 but blocked automated cleanup of test projects created via /api/projects during banner testing. Consider adding a delete endpoint or documenting this so test suites use a different cleanup path.

action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) Add authenticated DELETE /api/projects/{project_id} so tests can clean up TEST_ projects (currently 5 TEST_* projects left in demo_home DB from prior iterations + this run). Not a #54 blocker.

(Optional polish) In admin QuizzesModule AddQuiz, the default topic is topics[0] ('Tile & Grout'). The 'triggers' input is left empty by default — consider a placeholder example prefill so admins remember to add matching keywords for context-aware routing.
Sheet #54 is ready to ship — no required fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/quizzes/for-project/{project_id} uses simple substring keyword match — case-insensitive contains against title + context values. Works for the demo trigger words but a project title of e.g. 'Sanding & paint prep' would still match Painting via 'paint'. Acceptable for beta.
server.py POST /api/quizzes/{id}/submit does not throttle repeated attempts. A user could brute-force answer indices to earn the badge. Acceptable for MVP but flag for later abuse review.

frontend/app/skills.tsx uses useLocalSearchParams to auto-open the quiz on `?quizId=...`. useFocusEffect re-runs on every focus; setActive is guarded by params.quizId truthy, so navigating back into /skills after closing the modal would auto-reopen it. Consider clearing the param via router.setParams({quizId: undefined}) after opening. Minor UX polish, not a blocker.

frontend/src/components/SkillCheckBanner.tsx: `dismissed` is component-local state — banner will re-appear on next navigation to the project. Optional: persist dismissal per project_id in AsyncStorage.

QuizzesModule AddQuiz builder does not validate that at least one option is the correct answer for every question; UI defaults to index 0 which is fine, but if a user deletes/re-adds options manually the answer index can go stale. Backend clamps via `Math.min(x.answer, x.options.length-1)` — safe.
